site.title: Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library Quizzes
site.tagline: Preview a quiz, copy the snippet, paste it into any page on trlibrary.com.

_note: Placement is manual: paste the snippet for a given quiz id onto the page it belongs to. `placement` records the intended page for reference only - nothing reads it. `draft: true` means the quiz file does not exist yet.

quizzes.title: T.R. in the Badlands
quizzes.blurb: In 1883 a bespectacled New York assemblyman got off a train in Dakota Territory to hunt buffalo. He left three years later a cattleman. Fifteen questions on the country that made him.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt in buckskin, photographed in 1885

quizzes.title: The Making of a Boy
quizzes.blurb: Asthma nearly killed him. A bedroom museum, a taxidermy tutor, and a father who told him to make his body. Fifteen questions on the years before anyone had heard of him.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt as a small boy, about two years old

quizzes.title: The Youngest Man in the Assembly
quizzes.blurb: Elected at twenty-three, dismissed as a dude, and fighting the machine within a year. Fifteen questions on Roosevelt's first taste of power.
quizzes.imageAlt: The New York State Assembly, 1882-1884

quizzes.title: Fifteen Years to the White House
quizzes.blurb: Civil service reformer, police commissioner, governor, vice president — and then Buffalo. Fifteen questions on the climb.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt as Assistant Secretary of the Navy

quizzes.title: The Rough Riders
quizzes.blurb: A volunteer cavalry regiment of cowboys, Ivy League athletes, and lawmen, raised in weeks. Fifteen questions on 1898.
quizzes.imageAlt: Roosevelt and the Rough Riders on the captured hill

quizzes.title: The Square Deal
quizzes.blurb: Forty-two years old and suddenly president. Trusts, coal strikes, a canal, and a Nobel Prize. Fifteen questions on eight years.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt in his private office

quizzes.title: Two Hundred and Thirty Million Acres
quizzes.blurb: Parks, forests, monuments, bird reserves — the legacy that outlasted everything else he did. Fifteen questions on what he saved.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt and John Muir on Glacier Point, Yosemite

quizzes.title: After the White House
quizzes.blurb: An African safari, a third-party crusade, a bullet in the chest, and an unmapped river in the Amazon. Fifteen questions on his last decade.
quizzes.imageAlt: Roosevelt and Carl Akeley on the African expedition

quizzes.title: The People Around Him
quizzes.blurb: Edith, John Muir, Booker T. Washington, and the rivals who sharpened him. Fifteen questions on the company he kept.
quizzes.imageAlt: Portrait of Edith Kermit Carow Roosevelt

quizzes.title: Life at Sagamore Hill
quizzes.blurb: Six children, a pony in the White House lift, and a family tree that reaches Eleanor and Franklin. Fifteen questions on the Roosevelts at home.
quizzes.imageAlt: Roosevelt family portrait

quizzes.title: The Strenuous Life
quizzes.blurb: Boxing, judo, point-to-point walks through anything in the way. Fifteen questions on a creed he practised before he preached it.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt mounted in ranch clothes

quizzes.title: The Naturalist
quizzes.blurb: A boy who mounted his own specimens grew into a president who could out-argue ornithologists. Fifteen questions on Roosevelt and the natural world.
quizzes.imageAlt: Roosevelt reading in front of his tent in camp

quizzes.title: Where History Happened
quizzes.blurb: A Manhattan townhouse, a Badlands cabin, a hill above Oyster Bay, and the White House he renamed. Fifteen questions on the places that kept him.
quizzes.imageAlt: Roosevelt's birthplace at 28 East 20th Street

quizzes.title: The Author President
quizzes.blurb: Some thirty-five books and thousands of articles, most of them written after living the story first. Fifteen questions on Roosevelt in print.
quizzes.imageAlt: The library at Sagamore Hill

quizzes.title: Fact or Fiction
quizzes.blurb: He hated being called Teddy, and that is the least of it. Fifteen questions separating the famous stories from the record.
quizzes.imageAlt: Berryman's 1902 cartoon that started the teddy bear

quizzes.title: The Measure of the Man
quizzes.blurb: Mount Rushmore, presidential rankings, and a name on a national park. Fifteen questions on how America decided to remember him.
quizzes.imageAlt: The Fraser equestrian statue at the Roosevelt Memorial

quizzes.title: The Teddy Bear
quizzes.blurb: A president refused a shot he thought unsporting, a cartoonist drew it, and a Brooklyn shopkeeper wrote for permission to use the name. Twelve questions on how a Mississippi hunt made the world's most successful toy.
quizzes.imageAlt: Berryman's 1902 cartoon "Drawing the line in Mississippi"

quizzes.title: The White House Menagerie
quizzes.blurb: A badger named after the boy who caught it, a snake named after a thin aunt, and a pony that took the passenger lift. Twelve questions on the Roosevelt animals.
quizzes.imageAlt: Archie Roosevelt with Josiah, his pet badger

quizzes.title: The Twenty-Seventh of October
quizzes.blurb: Born on 27 October 1858 and married on the same date twenty-two years later. One birthday he spent walking the grounds with a bullet in his chest. Ten questions for the day itself.
quizzes.imageAlt: Theodore Roosevelt as a small boy, about two years old

quizzes.title: Christmas at the Roosevelts'
quizzes.blurb: The president who protected 230 million acres had reservations about cutting an evergreen. His nine-year-old son smuggled one into a closet anyway. Ten questions on Christmas in the Roosevelt house - including the last one.
quizzes.imageAlt: President Roosevelt seated between his sons Archie and Quentin, 1904

quizzes.title: Eight Thousand Handshakes
quizzes.blurb: Every New Year's Day the White House opened its doors and anyone willing to queue could shake the president's hand. On 1 January 1907 an awful lot of people did. Ten questions on the most exhausting tradition in American public life.
quizzes.imageAlt: Members of the public filing in to the White House for the New Year's reception

quizzes.title: The Dickinson Oration
quizzes.blurb: In 1886 a twenty-seven-year-old New York ranchman rode a freight train thirty-five miles to give a Fourth of July speech in a Dakota town six years old. One listener told him afterwards he would be president. Eleven questions on the best Independence Day in North Dakota history.
quizzes.imageAlt: Dickinson, Dakota Territory, in 1883

quizzes.title: The Roosevelts at War
quizzes.blurb: Four sons in France and Mesopotamia, a father refused the division he begged for, and a telegram that never came. Thirteen questions on the Roosevelts and the First World War.
quizzes.imageAlt: Quentin Roosevelt with his Nieuport aircraft

quizzes.title: Greatheart
quizzes.blurb: The nights his father drove him through the streets to force air into his lungs, the substitute he hired in 1861, and the verdict his son never revised. Fourteen questions on Theodore Roosevelt Senior.
quizzes.imageAlt: Portrait of Theodore Roosevelt Sr. hanging at Sagamore Hill, photographed in 1966

quizzes.title: The Path Between the Seas
quizzes.blurb: A French failure, a revolution that lasted a day, a doctor who fought mosquitoes, and the biggest earth-moving job ever attempted. Fifteen questions on the canal.
quizzes.imageAlt: A Bucyrus steam shovel working the Culebra Cut

quizzes.title: The River of Doubt
quizzes.blurb: An unmapped Amazon tributary, a Brazilian co-commander, a drowning, a murder, and an infected leg a thousand miles from help. Fifteen questions on the expedition that nearly killed him.
quizzes.imageAlt: Roosevelt and Candido Rondon on the Brazilian expedition

quizzes.title: Sixteen Battleships
quizzes.blurb: He had money to send them halfway and dared Congress to leave them there. Fourteen questions on the cruise that took the American navy round the world.
quizzes.imageAlt: The battle fleet leaving Hampton Roads

quizzes.title: The Body He Made
quizzes.blurb: Asthma, a warning about his heart, a blind eye nobody knew about, a bullet that stayed in, and fevers that came back until the end. Thirteen questions on sixty years of hard use.
quizzes.imageAlt: The 1912 X-ray plate showing the bullet in Roosevelt's chest

quizzes.title: The Peacemaker
quizzes.blurb: Two empires at war, a navy yard in Maine, a buffet lunch that solved an unsolvable protocol problem, and the first Nobel Prize ever won by an American. Fourteen questions.
quizzes.imageAlt: The Russian and Japanese envoys with Roosevelt aboard the Mayflower
